# Infoishai
> Infoishai is a free tech influencer marketplace connecting B2B brands with verified tech content creators across 9 countries.

## About
Infoishai helps brands find and hire tech influencers for product reviews, sponsored content, and creator partnerships. The platform lists verified creators on YouTube, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, and Instagram, covering 24 tech niches including AI, generative AI, SaaS, developer tools, cloud, cybersecurity, fintech, and consumer tech.

## Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://infoishai.com): Main marketplace search
- [Creator Directory](https://infoishai.com/creators): Browse all tech influencers
- [Tech Influencer Rates 2026](https://infoishai.com/blog/tech-influencer-rates-2026): Complete pricing guide
- [Find Tech YouTubers](https://infoishai.com/blog/how-to-find-tech-youtubers-product-reviews-2026): YouTube creator guide
- [First Campaign Guide](https://infoishai.com/blog/first-tech-influencer-campaign-startup-guide-2026): Startup guide

## For Brands
Free search and messaging. Infoishai is free for brands and creators. There are no platform fees. Filter creators by niche, platform, country, and engagement rate.

## For Creators
Free profile creation. Get discovered by brands. Set your own rates. Infoishai is free for brands and creators. There are no platform fees.
